scene_text.text: Waist-up candid phone snapshot of him caught mid-stride, walking briskly toward the camera along a shopping-mall viewing gallery, the frame tilted about 3 degrees as if grabbed in a hurry. He is a little off-centre toward picture-right, one shoulder ahead of the other, his weight moving forward. His head turns to the lens a moment late, his eyes just finding the camera, with a quick half-smile, one corner of the mouth lifted and the lips barely parted, a fleeting look rather than a pose. A white non-woven tote bag swings from his right shoulder at picture-left, its flat strap cut off by the left edge of the frame; the bag and his free hand, with a round black smartwatch on the wrist, are soft with motion blur. He wears an oversized, boxy cream cotton crew-neck t-shirt with short sleeves; across the chest is the print shown in the PRINT DESIGN image, copied exactly and kept sharp and flat: four centred lines of wide, round geometric sans-serif capital letters in a bright crimson red, reading I DON'T CARE / IF SHE GOT / RED FLAGS in bold, and I'M A BULL below them in a regular, thinner weight, filled solid red like the rest and not outlined. Behind him is a floor-to-ceiling glass wall with a dark metal frame, and beyond it only warm and white shop lights as soft blurred glows. He is the only person in the frame. Uneven, slightly warm indoor light; the focus lands on the print, so his face is a hair soft but recognisable; fine phone grain. Vertical 2:3 frame.
